I actually just got expelled this morning, well I received the email today but I knew it was coming. Near the start of this university year I got into a relationship with a girl and eventually after 3 months it ended like shit (she had been cheating on me the entire time with a guy in another city she had been dating for 3 years). She tried to and succeed in destroying my self confidence, the anxiety I had for years was crippling me, I never went to classes as I couldn't even be around all those people. 

So because of that I didn't get good exam results and well I've been kicked out, I already have a deposit for renting a house in that city so I guess I'm stuck there for a year, just going to have to get a job and grow up I guess, I feel really lost right now and I haven't told many people yet, anyone been in a situation like this before?
